Pistachio Delight
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, March 19, 2010 - 1:25am

Ingredients




1 pkt Pistachio instant pudding,lg
8 ounces Cool Whip
16 ounces Crushed Pineapple undrained
1 cup Walnuts Chopped
1 cup Colored Mini Marshmallows

Preparation

1 In large bowl mix pudding and cool whip together. Add pineapple with liquid and mix. Add walnuts and marshmallows. Refrigerate for 8 hours before serving. This is a very colorful and delicious salad or dessert. You will get a lot of compliments.
